fields.label: TCB Integration Enabled
fields.description: Master switch. When off, no outbound calls are made and no inbound payloads are processed (still logged if Log Only).

fields.label: Outbound Mode
fields.description: Off = no calls, no logs. Log Only = no live calls, all attempts logged. Live = real calls to TCB.

fields.label: Control Number Pattern
fields.description: Pattern used to generate TCB control numbers. '#' = random digit (filled by secrets.randbelow). All other characters are literal. Example: 99911####00## generates 13-digit references like 9991143790087.

fields.label: Decline Reference on SO Cancel
fields.description: When an unpaid Sales Order is cancelled, send a Reference Decline call to TCB so the control number cannot accept a payment.

fields.label: Decline Failure Policy
fields.options:
Allow Cancel and Flag
Block Cancel
fields.description: What to do if the TCB Decline call fails. Allow Cancel and Flag = cancel the SO anyway and mark the registry. Block Cancel = throw and prevent the SO cancellation.

fields.label: Inbound Mode
fields.description: Off = ignore IPNs. Log Only = log but never create Payment Entry. Apply Payment = create Payment Entry on matched control number.

fields.label: Auto-Apply Callback Payments
fields.description: When enabled and inbound mode is Apply Payment, IPN callbacks immediately create the Payment Entry. Otherwise the callback is logged for manual review.

fields.label: Callback Token
fields.description: Shared secret TCB sends in the callback header. Used to authenticate inbound IPN requests. Validated with hmac.compare_digest.

fields.label: Reconciliation Lookback Days
fields.description: How far back the daily reconciliation job pulls TCB rows.

fields.label: Profile ID / Account Number
fields.description: Profile / account number used as acctNo in decline calls.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Embedded in the URL path for live calls (treated as a secret).
